# GENERATED — DO NOT EDIT

`schema.ts` is generated from `packages/api-schema/openapi.json` by
`pnpm codegen`. Any hand-edit is overwritten on the next run and will make the
client disagree with the server.

Need a different shape? Change the Pydantic schema in `backend/`, run
`pnpm codegen`, and commit both files together.

This directory is owned by the backend owner in `.github/CODEOWNERS` and is
excluded from linting.
